summary.answer: InheritFrom is executed at the cited class assignments, not merely imported. Missing/falsy base throws explicit LUI Error. Otherwise makes a new table with super=base, sets its metatable __index=base, creates a fresh m_eventHandlers table with __index=base.m_eventHandlers, then returns the new class. It shares fallback handlers while permitting per-class handler writes. Does not instantiate widgets, invoke inherited callbacks or close anything. Metatable/native VM behavior and base fields are assumed, no further validation.

summary.answer: NewFromState errors for nil menu name, creates UIElement, optionally captures DEV model count and binds ModelToUse, applies overwrite name, initializes callback/pending lists, registers opened/menu name and cursor snapping; missing controller falls back to primary, cursor support adds focus-paths/subscription. NewForUIEditor creates button prompts and PC/shoutcaster key prompts, returns menu. DebugClose invokes close. UpdateButtonShownState scans condition-function rows, enables at first truthy result, otherwise preserves menu/element disabled states, then disables enabled prompt for animated occluder and writes final state. SetButtonLabel updates existing label/flags, handles one overlay-label hash, clears contextual flag outside free cursor, updates PC key flags after stripping two bits and refreshes cursor prompts. GetNavigationForMenu scans navigation groups/entries backward, returns first matching pair, otherwise no values. No callback registration alone proves button delivery; nil/native/lifetime limits are literal.
